title: Correct magnetic flux formula
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly apply Φ = B·A·sinθ for the square loop.

title: Square loop area calculation
description: Important Criteria: Student must compute the area of the square as (L/4)² = L²/16.

title: Final answer for part (1)
description: Essential Criteria: Student must arrive at Φ = (B L² sinθ)/16.

title: Maximum area recognition
description: Important Criteria: Student must recognize that maximum flux occurs when the loop is a circle (maximum area for given perimeter).

title: Circle area calculation
description: Important Criteria: Student must correctly compute the circle's radius from L = 2πr and area A = πr² = L²/(4π).

title: Final answer for part (2)
description: Essential Criteria: Student must arrive at Φ_m = B L²/(4π).

title: Angle misinterpretation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Using cosθ instead of sinθ for the flux through the inclined plane.

title: Perimeter-area confusion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Incorrectly relating wire length to side length (e.g., using L as side length instead of perimeter).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: Explicitly verifying that both final expressions have correct units of magnetic flux (Wb).
